elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Inserted clause: "TrueLink shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence" — affirmative obligation on the counterparty at the required amount and basis (per occurrence).

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: Same sentence: "...and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate" — aggregate limit expressly stated at the preferred figure.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: "professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000" — E&O at the preferred level.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: "where TrueLink processes Credit Data or Client Content, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000" — conditional trigger keyed to defined data categories used in this Agreement (Credit Data, Client Content), amount at the preferred USD 5M.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: "and workers' compensation insurance as required by law" — included in the same maintenance covenant.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: "TrueLink shall provide certificates of insurance on request." — certificate obligation runs from a request, as the checklist requires.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: E&O is set at USD 2,000,000, which satisfies the USD 1,000,000 floor.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Cyber/privacy is set at USD 5,000,000 where Credit Data or Client Content is processed, exceeding the USD 2,000,000 floor.

reasons: Preferred level is position-complete: all six elements (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, conditional cyber 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request) appear in single operative sentences, not merely in the margin comment.
Fallback is also satisfied a fortiori because the inserted E&O (2M) and cyber (5M) limits exceed the 1M/2M fallback floors.

Minimal: the insertion is a concise stand-alone paragraph for a genuinely missing clause. It omits the model-language extras that are not on the checklist — no 'at its own expense', no 'throughout the term and for one (1) year thereafter' survival tail, no additional audit/notice/additional-insured/waiver-of-subrogation mechanics — and adds nothing beyond the six preferred elements.

Preserves intent: the retained Section 30 force majeure text is unchanged and unaffected; the new paragraph creates no cross-reference and relies only on terms already defined in the Agreement (TrueLink, Credit Data, Client Content), so no dangling reference or undefined trigger results.

Nit only (do not treat as a defect in position): the inserted paragraph renders as an unnumbered heading 'INSURANCE.' immediately after Section 30 although the rationale describes it as new Section 31 — confirm the section number is applied on execution for consistency with the numbering of Sections 13-30.
